subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing emission point is clear, but schema, privacy/cardinality rules, and span relationship are public observability contract choices rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate spawn span only
options.body: Attach terminal failure information to the parent `sessions_spawn` tool span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths that occur after spawn returns.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle redesign
options.body: Fold this into broader subagent lifecycle reliability work, leaving downstream death clustering blind until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision mostly concerns diagnostics event/exporter contract shape, where current blame and recent area history point to this contributor as the best routing candidate.
